limitations: Source water-potability dataset is static; timestamps were synthetically generated.
Next-row pH is a pseudo-temporal target, not a measured future underwater observation.
The input model uses only current-row pH; it cannot represent interactions with other water-quality variables.
No dissolved oxygen or pressure columns are available in the source data.
No labelled anomaly ground truth exists; this analysis is forecasting error analysis, not anomaly detection evaluation.
The pH range buckets are descriptive groupings, not regulatory or safety thresholds.
Worst individual rows identify where this fitted model struggled; they do not establish physical causes.
